purpose: Map prototype semantics and behavior to ORIGINAL linked Figma instances. HTML is never the visual source of truth.

figmaLibrary.name: Altyn.Base
figmaLibrary.sourceOfTruth: Figma component sets, variants, sizes, visual appearance

usageRules: figmaTarget is the only specification for original linked instances. Never clone the HTML element as a substitute for the original Figma component.
htmlSource documents only selector, structure and flow; it does not establish original design tokens or variants.
Use componentSetId/componentId from figmaTarget; for partial status check only missing variant/property. For unmapped, do not invent a component ID.
Selectors resolve after entering screen sourceState; a selector may be reused on multiple screens without implying a shared instance.
parentId references an element id in the same screen. instanceKey is globally unique.
Country picker is an Input.mobile trigger plus a modal/list.mobile composition, with searchable=false; no standalone Figma Select component.
Do not re-create old stock state or postal code: both are absent from current prototype. Network aliases normalize to #network.
Figma bottom sheets in the current Physical card section use the native Altyn App modal and its slots. The HTML implementations remain separate.
The screens array describes HTML states. For Figma corrections, use only frames currently present in the target section; do not restore removed states.
